# Domo

> Domo is a cloud-native AI and data platform that integrates, transforms, and visualizes data from 1,000+ sources to enable real-time business intelligence, automation, and embedded analytics.

Domo provides an integrated suite of tools for data integration (Magic ETL, connectors), business intelligence (dashboards, visualizations), workflow automation (Domo Workflows, AI agents), and app development (App Studio, App Dev Framework). The platform combines data preparation, analytics, and automation capabilities with enterprise security and compliance features.
